text:
nina_docs: FYI I tried the onboarding quickstart in a Cloudflare Worker and it blew up after the package.json export map change. Repro: `npm i @redwood/sdk-js && import sdk from '@redwood/sdk-js'` -> Worker logs: "Uncaught TypeError: Failed to resolve import".
ajay_sdk: What did we land in the exports map?
nina_docs: We switched to an ESM-first conditional: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": { "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs" },
    "default": "./dist/node/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./utils": "./dist/node/utils.mjs"
}
```
ron_build: Edge runtimes (Workers/Deno/Bun edge) don't implement the Node-only `node` conditional. They end up trying to resolve the path literally and fail. Bundlers like vite/rollup may also pick different entrypoints depending on resolution.
zoe_types: Also hitting TypeScript lookup problems in the quickstart: TS can't find types because `types` is nested under the `node` conditional. `tsc` on a fresh install reports it can't find `index.d.ts`.
ajay_sdk: Two problems: runtime resolution for edge + TS types lookup. Short-term patch: add explicit edge/browser/deno/worker fields that point to `./dist/edge/index.mjs` and expose a root `./types` export so TS resolver can find it outside conditionals. Eg: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "worker": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "deno": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "browser": "./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "node": { "import": "./dist/node/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs" },
    "default": "./dist/node/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```
ron_build: For folks still using `require('@redwood/sdk-js')` we'll get `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` if package.json has `type: "module"`. We should either keep a `main` fallback that points to `dist/node/index.cjs` or include `require` under `exports.".".node`. That unblocks older CommonJS sample apps.
zoe_types: Add a tiny TS test in CI that runs `tsc --skipLibCheck` against a minimal import to assert types resolve from an installed package. Saves us from regressions.
ajay_sdk: Plan: I'll open a small patch to add the extra conditionals + top-level `./types` export, add `node.require` target, and publish a patch. Also will add an explanation in CHANGELOG about ESM-first exports and edge compatibility notes.
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary: onboarding-samples (main) - 6/10 edge sample runs failed with unresolved import errors. Ticket #1243 created. Logs attached.
nina_docs: Thanks. I'll update onboarding quickstart with a compatibility note (prefer `import` in ESM runtimes, but show `require` workaround) and link the canary ticket so we can track.
ron_build: Medium-term: we should add an automated matrix test that installs the package in Node (CJS/ESM), Cloudflare Worker, Deno, and a browser-compat bundler scenario (Vite). That'll catch conditional export regressions.
ajay_sdk: Agreed. For now shipping a patch release with the fallbacks + a CJS compatibility artifact should get the samples green. I'll CC the sample repo owners in the PR.
